cc:Work.dc:description: Report-derived values. Rho interpolates between mandatory and all-candidate boundaries; it is not a total-budget fraction. At rho=0, no-packing retention excludes 2 absent contexts (n=78); success includes all 80 runs. No CIs reported for these means. Sources: docs/experiments/reports/budget-pressure-analysis-2026-11-11.md
